author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Attackers are exploiting the patched Ghost CMS flaw CVE-2026-26980, compromising over 700 unpatched sites, including universities. title: Ghost CMS flaw abused to push ClickFix attacks on hundreds of sites

description: A hacker is selling a 340M-strong OnlyFans-linked dataset built by correlating old breaches and public data, not by hacking OnlyFans directly. title: 340 Million OnlyFans Profiles Allegedly Rebuilt from Leaks

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A zero-click attack targeting iPhones on iOS 16 hijacked WhatsApp accounts without linked devices, warnings, or user interaction. title: Zero-Click WhatsApp Account Takeover Hits iPhone Users Running iOS 16. No Linked Devices, No Warning

author: Pierluigi Paganini

title: Dutch authorities dismantle hosting network allegedly used for cyberattacks and disinformation
